title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.4, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.16, a user who does not hold the "admin" or…
description: Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.4, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.16 contain a vulnerability where non-admin and non-power users can access indexed events that should be hidden by their role's srchFilter setting via the search jobs REST API. Additionally, these users can bypass SPL safeguards for risky commands within indexes they can search. This occurs because required field values are not properly escaped in internally generated searches.
